physicalNotes: No radius or mass of MACS J0025 is recorded here: its package frames it at 1,041,069 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), MACS J0025.4-1222: position from 2011MNRAS.410.1939Z, redshift from 2024A&A...690A.322K (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=MACS%20J0025.4-1222); NED preferred values of MACS J0025.4-1222: RA 6.372420833°, Dec -12.37696111° (2011MNRAS.410.1939Z); redshift 0.584 (2024A&A...690A.322K)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.584 (NED, 2024A&A...690A.322K) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 2221586199.256822 pc, the Planck18 parameters as Astropy defines them, integrated in this repository's work and checked against two distances Astropy gave (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 0.584: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space.
